hook: Most of us were doing homework. He was doing this.

items.label: Baby Debut Goal
items.line: Sixteen, first La Liga goal, and he celebrates like he's done it a thousand times.
items.clip_hint: Lamine Yamal first La Liga goal, Granada vs Barcelona, Oct 2023

items.label: Bernabéu Silence
items.line: Seventeen years old, scores at the Bernabéu, and the whole stadium goes on mute.
items.clip_hint: Lamine Yamal goal, Real Madrid 0-4 Barcelona, Bernabéu, Oct 2024

items.label: Final Assist
items.line: Euro final. One pass. Defense deleted. Bro plays like he has a cheat code.
items.clip_hint: Lamine Yamal assist to Nico Williams, Spain vs England, Euro 2024 final

items.label: Title Curler
items.line: Title on the line and he curls it into the top corner. No pressure, apparently.
items.clip_hint: Lamine Yamal curler vs Espanyol that clinched La Liga, May 2025

items.label: Inter Nightmare
items.line: Champions League semifinal, five defenders, and he walks through all of them. Seventeen. Seventeen!
items.clip_hint: Lamine Yamal solo goal vs Inter, Champions League semifinal 1st leg, Apr 2025

outro: Is he already better than Messi at that age? Comment.
